title: Recovery conflict uses self-asserted earliest ts
description: SPEC l.250 resolves competing RecoveryAssertions by earliest self-asserted ts. An attacker holding a recovery key can backdate and win. Fix: order by an external anchor (log inclusion, witnessed timestamp) or require explicit precedence rules not under signer control. See also agora-pozi.19 (transparency log). Line numbers refer to import/ files (notes/research-2026-10-16.md).
close_reason: Fixed in be91134 (phase B); verified in text 2026-10-16
